text: あっち　いかねえと　ぶんなぐるぞ！

structure.jp: あっち　いかねえと

patterns.name: 〜ないと
patterns.explanation: ないと means 'if you don't', followed by what will happen; ねえ is a rough spoken form of ない. いかねえと = 'if you don't go'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, mostly male way to push a statement hard, here as a threat. ぶんなぐるぞ = 'I'll punch you, I mean it'.
